claim_text: A covering that had been sewn down over Yellowstone by prayer being unstitched and lifted because of corruption and how people voted, with a major earthquake following and fires from gas coming up through the earth all through British Columbia and into Alaska.
quote: I saw an unsoing of Yellowstone
falsify_match: A major eruption or earthquake at Yellowstone.
falsify_miss: Yellowstone stays at background activity. Tying the covering to voting means the claim explains itself either way: prayer holds it down, or corruption lifts it.
